label: Potions tier list

items.verdict: day-long speak with animals; saves a spell known or prepared, mostly roleplay value
clears poisoned and poison-inflicted conditions; carry one or two as a panic button
un-petrifies; effectively story-only, almost no mechanical payoff
bonus-action cost blocks in-combat use; good for traversal if no one prepares the ritual
resistance to all damage, hovering and squeezing through grates for a bonus action
tripled jump for 10 turns; pre-combat repositioning, close to free Misty Step
7 healing for a bonus action, and the cheapest way to throw a downed ally back up
strictly better than the basic potion, but 14 vs 7 rarely changes the outcome; not worth upgrading to
28 average healing is more than most healers give with an action; real in-combat healing
rated S+ ABOVE THE SCALE: 45 reliable healing for a bonus action breaks the hit point economy
detect thoughts without concentration; bypasses some dialogue checks, no combat use
antidote plus disease cure; diseases are rare, so no reason to seek it out
rated S+ ABOVE THE SCALE: 3 turns of haste, no concentration; on Honour the extra action loses Extra Attack
clears blinded, silenced, paralysed and poisoned; the best of the three cure potions to carry
short rest if you sleep two turns; longevity tool, best on warlocks and sorlocks
a full long rest in two turns; extends the day and skips camp-triggered story events
10 turns of flight with no slot or concentration; the king of mobility
bonus-action escape or advantage on the next attack; also opens story routes
a Con save or you are knocked out three rounds; pure downside
puts you to sleep two rounds with no upside; an Angelic Reprieve without the benefit
disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma checks for three rounds; roleplay only
resistance to ALL damage for 10 turns; counted here as a potion because it uses no elixir slot

unassigned.why: Terazul (the fourth drug) is discussed at length as busted -- stacking haste for two turns, free to consume -- but no letter is ever spoken, so no tier is recorded

count_note: Off by +1: Terazul is discussed at length but never given a letter, so it sits in unassigned without being a verdict.
